No, Building 12 is **not empty**.
According to the latest data:
- **Building 12 · Damaged apartment block · ~656 people (est.)**
- Status: **unsearched** - Team 2 is ready and awaiting your ack to send there
The "656 people" figure is an occupancy estimate calculated from footprint (9,842 m² × 50% built × 4 floors ÷ 30 m² per person), not a confirmed count. But it's highly likely people were inside at collapse time (04:17 Feb 6).
Ready for you to dispatch Team 2 when you are.
